text:
Priya Sharma: Hey team — first day! I followed the onboarding docs but I can't see any k8s contexts in my kubeconfig. `kubectl config get-contexts` returns nothing. I need to work in a personal dev namespace (priya-dev). Who should I ping for kubeconfig/namespace/RBAC?

Michael Lee: welcome Priya :tada: Quick q — are you on Okta SSO + device enrolled? If not the SSO step will block kube auth. Also which cluster do you need (dev/staging/prod)?

Priya Sharma: thx! I'm on Okta and my laptop is enrolled. I need the dev cluster for feature work. My Okta email is priya.sharma@redwood.ai.

Michael Lee: got it. 2 quick things to try while we route:
1) confirm contexts: `kubectl config view --minify --raw`
2) confirm your current user token: `kubectl whoami --short` (if available)
If those fail, Jamie / Dev can create a namespace and rolebinding for you. I'll loop them in.

Michael Lee: @Jamie Ortiz @Devon Park can you grant priya a namespaced edit role in dev? Namespace name: priya-dev. She should be able to list/get pods and port-forward.

Jamie Ortiz: ack, looking. Can you paste the output of `kubectl config view --raw` (no secrets pasted — just the contexts block) or confirm the cluster name shown in the onboarding doc (redwood-dev)?

Priya Sharma: paste below (sanitized):
```
contexts:
- context:
    cluster: redwood-dev
    user: okta:priya.sharma@redwood.ai
  name: redwood-dev
```

Priya Sharma: cluster is redwood-dev.

Devon Park: I'll create the namespace and rolebinding now. Creating a RoleBinding to give `edit` in namespace priya-dev to the Okta user principal.

Devon Park: done — rolebinding `rb-priya-dev-edit` created in namespace `priya-dev`. Takes a few seconds to propagate. I also added a note to the ticket.

Michael Lee: once it's applied, try: `kubectl get pods -n priya-dev` and then set the default namespace with `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=priya-dev`

Priya Sharma: running now... `kubectl get pods -n priya-dev` -> permission denied: "User \"okta:priya.sharma@redwood.ai\" cannot list resource \"pods\" in API group \"\" in the namespace \"priya-dev\""

Jamie Ortiz: weird, give me 30s — sometimes the Okta-to-k8s mapping requires a re-sync. @onboard-bot can you refresh cluster auth mapping for priya?

onboard-bot: Requested a directory sync for priya.sharma@redwood.ai. Job queued (job-id: sync-2026-03-23-001).

Jamie Ortiz: sync finished, re-check now.

Priya Sharma: ok `kubectl get pods -n priya-dev` -> no resources found. I can list now. Thanks!

Priya Sharma: set default namespace too and port-forward works: `kubectl port-forward svc/my-service 8080:80 -n priya-dev` connected. :thumbsup:

Michael Lee: excellent. I've added a quick note to the onboarding doc about the typical sync delay and the exact error message to watch for.

Devon Park: also FYI — if you need a service account for CI/automation later, open a request in #eng-infra with the service account name and required verbs. We avoid granting cluster-wide perms during onboarding.

Priya Sharma: will do. Thanks everyone for the fast help :raised_hands: super excited to be here!

Michael Lee: welcome again — if anything else blocks during your first week ping @devex.
